disc.built_as: check_f2_footprint.py: validated forward projection, disc of radius 22 px at 25 m, amplitude = valid_native.tif

correlation.model: separable product of the chosen per-axis correlograms; Gaussian copula on Gamma(N, 1/N) for X and Y independently; CPR = 0.7 X / Y

complex_field.model: L equal-weight looks per circular channel, each a separable AR(1) circular complex Gaussian field; intensity lag-one correlations = the delivered LH product's; channels independent (the independent-channel null); both set to zero outside F2's amplitude mask, 5x5 boxcar, then CPR = c box(SC) / box(OC)

look_calibration.matched_on: the boxcar'd field's patch-mode ENL (where CPR is formed)
look_calibration.first_version: offered L = 5, 6 only; boxcar'd ENL 21-24, a null at the wrong operating point; superseded 2026-09-23

paper_convention: f2_peak_cpr is the expected maximum of independent F(2N,2N) draws at TRUE CPR 0.7 over 1520 pixels (raw) or 24.7 effective samples: its N = 5 rows, 7.38 and 2.52, are reproduced here by independent_max_true_cpr_0p7 at 1521 and 25 samples (7.377, 2.528). independent_max_true_cpr_1p0_over_disc is the same quantity at true CPR 1 and is NOT the paper's convention

complex_field_v2.model: independent circular channels (gamma_c = 0), CPR 1.00, DOP 0; 4 looks per channel as the first complex run chose; the cross product is kept so the sample DOP can be formed per cell from the boxcar'd covariance, with the production zero-fill

per_pixel.verdict: the per-pixel excess is NOT confined to the edge cells: interior cells exceed 5 % too

joint_rule_on_null.rule: sample CPR > 1 AND sample DOP < 0.13, per cell

complex_field_v3.model: L equal-weight looks per circular channel; per look, OC = sqrt(b) w_OC and SC = sqrt(a) (gamma_c w_OC + sqrt(1 - gamma_c^2) w_SC), w exactly stationary separable AR(1) complex fields at each channel's lag-one field correlation (sqrt of the intensity lag-one), a = CPR/(1+CPR), b = 1/(1+CPR), gamma_c from DOP^2 = q^2 + gamma_c^2 (1 - q^2); zero outside F2's 260-px amplitude mask, 5 x 5 boxcar on SC, OC and the cross product, then per cell R = box SC / box OC and the sample DOP

complex_SC_OC.source: complex_grid_correlation.json::lag_correlation_before_boxcar (Stokes SC and OC of the complex product, physical sign)
